manifest.validation_protocol: H1 leave-one-positive-region-out (P@k, R@k, R-precision, NDCG@k); H2 independent Gaussian noise

mission_spec.objective: Rover traction and navigation on rough slopes under low sun (synthetic demo)

transfer_requirements.engineering_decision: Navigation camera / LiDAR performance in long shadows
Optics and dust behaviour in vacuum
Sinkage and slip under sustained 1/6 g

mechanisms.description: Wheel-soil shear in loose granular material
mechanisms.note: Volcanic tephra fields and simulant soil bins approximate shear; 1/6 g needs a correction model.

mechanisms.description: Multi-hour sun elevation below ~3° with long shadows sweeping in azimuth
mechanisms.note: Declared condition (input data): sustained in the field only at high latitude, in specific seasonal windows.

mechanisms.description: Radiative-only heat exchange and dust behaviour in high vacuum
mechanisms.note: Only thermal-vacuum chambers; no field site has vacuum.

mechanisms.description: Continuous 1/6 g loading of soil and vehicle
mechanisms.note: Parabolic flights give seconds only; sustained 1/6 g is irreducible on Earth.

what_would_change_decision: RmsSlope1x = 34.000 deg must be [2, 24] (HC_SAFE_SLOPE); only a different site or a mission-approved relaxation changes this.
Valid-pixel coverage must rise from 0.55 to >= 0.85 (re-acquire or gap-fill the DEM).
Resolution 30.0 m vs target 2.0 m exceeds ratio 4.0; resample or use a DEM closer to 2.0 m.

mode_rankings.eligibility_rule: Cells within epsilon (QC-valid, hard constraints passed) on Pareto fronts of (-d_mission, data quality); cells beyond epsilon follow as near-misses ordered by d_mission (front 0).
d_mission <= epsilon AND rarity status SupportedRareCombination (outliers excluded).
d_mission <= epsilon AND outside every catalogued analog cluster; Pareto of (-d_mission, km from catalog).
